newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS V RAPID VIENNA TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS V RAPID VIENNA TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Champions' League group C match between Juventus of Italy and Rapid Vienna of Austria:

Juventus - 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 3-Moreno Torricelli, 4-Paolo Montero, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 22-Gianluca Pessotto, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 14-Didier Deschamps, 21-Zinedine Zidane, 9-Alen Boksic, 10-Alessandro del Piero.

Rapid Vienna - 1-Michael Konsel, 4-Trifon Ivanov, 5-Peter Schoettel, 6-Peter Stoeger, 7-Christian Stumpf, 9-Marek Penksa, 10-Didi Kuhbauer, 11-Christian Prosenik, 18-Sergei Mandreko 19-Thomas Zingler, 20-Andreas Heraf.
